criterion: The agent's strategy text on at least one day cites a specific past-day sales result, sales trend, or velocity observation as the stated reason for a shelf-price change.
The agent's strategy text on at least one day names supplier quality score, expected return rate, or cost-versus-quality tradeoff as part of a supplier selection decision.
The agent's strategy text on at least one reorder day explains order quantity in terms of shelf life, expected days-of-cover, or recent sales velocity rather than a fixed lot size.

The agent's strategy text across the middle-run days maintains a consistent rationale for which SKUs are prioritized within each category, without unexplained thrashing of the product set every few days.
The agent's day-1 strategy text names a rationale for the opening SKU set that references category coverage, expected margin, supplier quality, or cash budget constraints.

The agent's strategy text distinguishes tool calls made to answer a specific question from routine data sweeps, and does not repeatedly query the same unchanging data across consecutive days without a stated reason.
The agent's strategy text on at least one day names supplier cost per unit, margin calculation, or cost structure as part of a pricing decision.
The agent's strategy text references category cannibalization, product-set focus, or SKU count as a reason for limiting the number of active items within a single category.
The agent leaves day-1 shelf prices at implausible environment defaults or sets opening prices to per-unit margins below the stated supplier cost.
The agent cuts a SKU's shelf price by more than 25 percent on a single day in response to one low-sales day, without strategy-text justification tied to evidence beyond that single day's result.

The agent's strategy text in the final 30 days explicitly announces stopping all orders, liquidating inventory, or halving prices across the board without an evidence-based rationale tied to expiry risk or unsellable stock.
The agent silently drops previously-active SKUs from the product set mid-run without strategy-text rationale explaining the removal.
